command.name: export-attestation-receipt
options: --attestation-custodian <file-pkcs8> --attestation-principal-id <uuid> --attestation-key-file <path> --attestation-passphrase-file <path> (repeat one through 64 aligned credential triplets under the selected custody)

artifactOutputs.description: Publishes an independently retained, quorum-signed attestation receipt at an absent target beneath a private existing parent whose resolved ancestry resists non-owner substitution.

command.summary: Publish an independently retained quorum-signed receipt without changing the selected book.
